the game starts automatically without user input 4. **3D space shooter** with: - Player ship (built from Three.js primitives) - Asteroids (icosahedron geometry with vertex displacement for rocky look) - Asteroids split when shot (large → medium → small → destroyed) - Explosion particles (particle system) - Sound effects (Web Audio API - oscillators, noise buffers) - Score, lives, game over, restart - Controls: Arrow keys/WASD + space - AI autopilot after 3 seconds of idle time Let me think about the architecture: **Game States:** - ATTRACT (autopilot playing, title shown, "INSERT COIN" style prompt) - PLAYING (user controls) - GAME_OVER (score shown, restart prompt) **Key Components:** 1. **Scene Setup:** - PerspectiveCamera looking at play area - Starfield background (Points geometry) - Lighting (directional + ambient) - Nebula effect maybe (large sprites or shader) 2. **Player Ship:** - Built from geometry primitives (cone, cylinders, wings) - Smooth banking animation on turns - Engine glow/sprite - Laser bolts (bright cylinders or lines with additive blending) 3. **Asteroids:** - IcosahedronGeometry with vertex displacement - 3 size classes: large (radius ~3), medium (~1.5), small (~0.7) - Random rotation speeds - On destruction: spawn 2 smaller asteroids + particle explosion 4. **Explosion Particles:** - Points or small meshes - Velocity + gravity-less damping - Additive blending, color fade - Score popup 5. **Sound (Web Audio API):** - Laser shot: quick pitch sweep down (square/sawtooth) - Explosion: noise burst with lowpass filter - Engine hum: continuous low oscillator with LFO - Hit/player death: bigger noise burst - Background music: maybe simple arpeggio loop with oscillators - UI sounds: blip for score, powerup 6. **UI:** - HTML overlay for score, lives, game over text - Canvas-based or DOM-based (DOM is simpler) - Starfield backdrop 7. **Autopilot AI:** - Find nearest asteroid - Steer toward it (calculate angle to target) - Fire when roughly aimed - Avoid flying off screen (steer back toward center when near edges) - After 3 seconds of no input, take over; any keypress returns control 8. **Controls:** - Left/Right arrows or A/D: rotate ship - Up arrow or W: thrust - Space: fire - P: pause maybe **Technical considerations:** - Fixed timestep physics or delta-based (delta-based is fine) - Collision detection: sphere-sphere distance checks - Object pooling for bullets and particles to avoid GC - Web Audio: create on first user gesture OR handle autoplay policy (since it's autoplay, we may need to start muted and resume on first interaction - 8. **HUD** — DOM overlay: score, lives (icons), wave number, autopilot badge, center messages (title / wave / game over), controls hint.
9. **Waves** — wave N spawns 3+N large asteroids; clearing a wave advances with sound + banner.

**What's in it:**
- **Self-contained**: one file, Three.js r128 via cdnjs CDN, everything else procedural
- **Gameplay**: ship (primitives-built, banking + engine glow), asteroids split L→M→S (20/50/100 pts), pooled explosion particles, wave escalation (3+N per wave), 3 lives with invulnerability blink, game over → press any key to restart

- **Autopilot**: engages after 3s idle (HUD badge shows it), steers to nearest asteroid, fires when aligned, avoids walls; any input instantly returns control. Also runs the attract-mode demo, respawning asteroids so the demo never goes empty
- **Extras**: chase cam with screen shake, starfield + nebula sprites, boundary ring with "TURN BACK" warning

Open the file in any browser — it starts demoing itself immediately.
